items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: What's his name? Roy Johnson. Oh, that's her brother.

ctx.x: I'm pretty sure because--Prez is gone, but I'm pretty sure--he was crazy about her. And I believe he got her on that.
If he did, it's an interesting point. I mean, you know, it's surprising how many times she's mentioned in books and things like that.
